featured.name: Official ETS2 Convoy - September 2026
featured.description:
### Our Official September Convoy of 2026 has been scheduled and you're **all invited**! 👀  

> This month, we are heading to Edirne, traveling through Turkey, Bulgaria & Romania to Iași.

The event takes place on the **19th September 2026** at **17:00 UTC!**  


---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your time by zone following **[this](https://notime.zone/OyTN4LveUbiJ1)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/36983.1785068670.png)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Edirne** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you to what company to park in.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](https://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/120939-official-ets2-convoy-september-2026/)**!

featured.name: Official ATS Convoy - Diesel shortage
featured.description:
### You're **all invited** to haul diesel to Kingman Arizona! 👀  

> Coastline Mining has an urgent shortage of diesel to run all their mining equipment and request your assistance!

The event takes place on the **26th September 2026** at **17:00 UTC!**  

---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your timezone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P01ZlW49IXHTy)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/37508.1787823642.jpg)

---

### :truck: | **Cargo**  

We kindly request you to haul diesel  

You can use our TruckersMP Truck Delivery Dispatcher to select your cargo to Coastline Mining in Kingman.

![Truck Delivery Dispatcher](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/a4ebd34d-accb-4852-9da9-5633020befb0.avif)  

If you want to know more about our Truck Delivery Dispatcher you can read this [article](https://truckersmp.com/knowledge-base/article/1410)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **San Francisco** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you into Coastline Mining.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](https://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/120680-official-ats-convoy-animal-transporting/)**!

today.description:
![](https://images.pixieset.com/798473001/8cab5b08face561d90902d672b95992f-xxlarge.png)

## **Join Us on an Exciting Journey: Our First Double-Trailer Convoy Through Germany**

### We are thrilled to announce a ground-breaking adventure as we embark on our very first double-trailer convoy! Starting from the vibrant city of Nürnberg, right at the doorstep of AI Automotive, we will navigate the scenic and bustling roads of Germany. Our convoy will make its way northwards, culminating at the renowned Hannover Expo in Hannover as is a hub of innovation and industry.
 
### This convoy is not just any ordinary drive; it’s a bold step into uncharted territory for us. Managing a double-trailer convoy presents unique challenges and opportunities, from maneuvering through traffic to coordinating logistics across multiple vehicles. We’ll be sharing every moment of this journey and the excitement of driving these impressive rigs through some of Germany’s most iconic routes.
-----

# Event Information 
### 🚛 Imperial Cargo VTC — September Convoy 👑
​
Imperial Cargo VTC proudly invites you to join us for our official Grand Opening Convoy! Come celebrate the launch of our community with an evening of professional driving, great scenery, and an unforgettable convoy experience alongside drivers from across the TruckersMP community.
​
📅 Date: Saturday, 16, september 2026
🕒 Meetup Time: 19:00 UTC
🚦 Departure Time: 20:00 UTC
🎮 Game: Euro Truck Simulator 2
🗺 DLC Required: NONE (WOW)
📍 Departure: klangenfurt am worthersee (Slots)
🏁 Destination: munich Quarry'
📦 Cargo: Own Choice (see rules)
​
🌄 Route Information:
This convoy route has been carefully selected to provide a scenic and enjoyable driving experience featuring winding mountain roads, beautiful landscapes, and immersive Alpine scenery.
​
📢 Convoy Guidelines:
• Please follow all TruckersMP rules
• Listen to Event Staff and Convoy Control
• Keep a safe distance between trucks
• No reckless driving or overtaking
• Be respectful to all participants
​
👥 Why Attend?
• Celebrate another month of Imperial Cargo
• Meet new drivers and VTCs
• Enjoy a professional convoy atmosphere
• Become part of a growing trucking community
​
We look forward to seeing you on the road and sharing this special event with the community.
​
🚚 Imperial Cargo VTC — Drive Safe. Drive Smart. Drive Imperial.

# Temporary Rules
## Approved by Event Management
## Event Rules for Participants

***🚛 Imperial Cargo VTC — Convoy Rules & Regulations 👑***

To ensure a safe and enjoyable convoy experience, all participants must follow the rules below.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

# 📋 General Rules

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

• All TruckersMP rules apply at all times
• Respect Event Staff, Convoy Control, and participants
• Reckless driving, trolling, or dangerous behaviour is prohibited
• Overtaking is not allowed unless instructed by Event Staff
• Maintain professionalism throughout the event
• No Double trailers-HCT are permitted in this event

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## 🚦 Driving Rules

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

• Keep a safe distance from the truck ahead
• Stay in the assigned convoy lane
• Follow the convoy speed set by Convoy Control
• Use indicators when turning or changing lanes
• Avoid sudden braking or dangerous manoeuvres
• Free roaming on the server is prohibited
• Participants with consistent lag must remain at the back
• All Event Staff instructions must be followed

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## 📡 Communication Rules

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

• Follow instructions from Convoy Control and Event Staff
• Do not argue with staff during the event
• Report issues respectfully after the convoy if required

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## 🅿 Meetup & Departure Rules

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

• Arrive on time and park in your assigned slot
• Drivers without a slot must use 'Public Parking'
• Do not block roads, fuel stations, or service areas
• Leave the starting location only when instructed
• Depart in an orderly one-by-one manner
• Cars and buses are prohibited except authorised Event Staff vehicles
• Headlights should remain on when appropriate

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## ⚠ Disciplinary Actions

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Failure to follow the rules may result in:
• Verbal warnings
• Removal from the convoy
• Exclusion from future Imperial Cargo events

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## Event Rules for Event Staff

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
